page.layout: One page of text in a single column; a narrow column of marginal notes on the left edge, partly cut off by the binding; running head "B P" centred at top; page number 93 at top right.

main_text.p: Βρᾳδύνω tardo, 1.Tim.3. 15. Fut. βρᾳδυνῶ. a.1. ἐβρᾳδύνωσα.
Βρᾳδυπλοέω ῶ tardè navigo (verbum compositum ex βρᾳδὺς tardus, & πλοῶ ης ὁ navigatio.) F.ήσω. P.βεβρᾳδυπλόηκα.
Βραχὺς εῖα ὐ brevis e, Luc.22.58. μετὰ βραχὺ paulo post, Johan.6.7. βραχὺ τι paululum, Heb.13.22. ἐκ βραχέων paucis.
Βρέφος ε̅ος τὸ embryo, infans, puer, Luc.1.41.
Βρέχω pluo, rigo, humecto. F. βρέξω. P. βέβρεχα. a.1. ἔβρεξα. a.1.infin. βρέξαι pluere, Luc.7.38. βρέξαν τὰς πόδας δακρύοιν, rigare pedes lacrymis. P.med. βέβρογα.
Βροντὴ ῆς ἡ tonitru, Apoc.16.18. βροντάω ὦ tono. F.ήσω. P.βεβρόντηκα.
Βροχὴ ῆς ἡ pluvia vehemens, pluvia procellosa, nimbus, Matth.7.25.
Βρόχος ὁ laqueus, restis, ἀβρόχος ὁ guttur, extrito γ, quod restis circa guttur suspendendis circumponi soleat, 1.Cor.7.35.
Βρύχω stridō. imperf. ἔβρυχον, Act.7.54. F. βρύξω. P.βέβρυχα. P.pass. βεβρυγμαι.
Βρύω mano, fundo, scateo, Jac.3.11. F. βρύσω. P.βέβρυκα. a.1. ἔβρυσα.
Βρώσκω pro quo etiam dicitur βιβρώσκω cómedo. Fut.βρώσω. P.βέβρωκα, Johan.6.13. prat. pass.βεβρωμαι.

page.notes: Marginal notes on the left edge are cut off and mostly illegible; only fragments such as "18.", "Luc.22.41", "Philem.1", "v.13." and "certami" are visible, and were not transcribed in full. The Greek is transcribed as far as legible; some accents and breathings are uncertain.
